detail.longDescription:
100% Agentless Server Management — No extra tools needed on your servers!

DaRemote is a powerful, lightweight remote server monitor and management client built for SysAdmins, DevOps engineers, and Homelab enthusiasts. Easily monitor your Linux servers, manage Docker containers, and establish fast SSH / SFTP connections right from your phone, tablet, or foldable device.

Connected purely via standard SSH, DaRemote tracks real-time system metrics without installing any monitoring agents or background daemons on your remote hosts.

🖥️ Wide OS & Environment Support
Perfect for cloud VPS, self-hosted homelabs, NAS, and single-board computers:
• Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, Fedora, Raspberry Pi OS, OpenWrt, BusyBox, etc.
• BSD & Routers: FreeBSD, OPNsense, pfSense
• Containers: Docker, Podman, Apple Container
• Desktop OS: macOS & Windows (via OpenSSH)

📊 Real-Time Server Monitoring Dashboard
• CPU: Per-core load, real-time usage, and hardware temperature.
• Memory & Swap: Total capacity and active memory allocation.
• Processes: Switch between Top 10 or 30 active processes with uptime, PID, resource usage, and a quick-kill menu to terminate tasks.
• Disk & S.M.A.R.T: Partition mount points, storage capacity, real-time read/write speeds, and S.M.A.R.T health status.
• Network: Inbound/outbound traffic speeds per interface, total data transfer, and active TCP connections.

🐳 Docker & Container Management
• View container status, resource usage, and runtime details at a glance.
• Quickly start, restart, pause/unpause, or stop containers on the go.

⚡ Script & Command Snippet Automation
• Organize, edit, and execute custom shell scripts with clean output display.
• Batch Execution: Run commands across multiple servers simultaneously.
• Built-in support for Wake-on-LAN (WoL) and SSH Tunnel forwarding.

💻 Full-Featured SSH Terminal & SFTP Client
• xterm-256color compatible terminal emulation with adapted shortcut keyboard for mobile and tablets.
• Biometric Sudo: Use fingerprint/biometrics to securely auto-fill your sudo password.
• Built-in SFTP: Browse, upload, download, and manage remote server files seamlessly.
• Flexible Proxies: Full support for SSH Jump Hosts / Tunnels, HTTP Proxy, and SOCKS5 Proxy.

🎨 Modern Android Experience
• Optimized split-screen layout for tablets and foldables.
• Material You dynamic color themes with Dark and Light modes.
• Multi-language support: English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Português (Brasil), Italiano, Türkçe, Deutsch.

🔒 Privacy & Security First
Your server credentials, SSH private keys, and host configurations are strictly encrypted and stored locally on your device. DaRemote never uploads or shares your sensitive server data with any cloud server.

🎁 Flexible Trial & Free Tier
• Free Forever: Manage up to 3 servers completely free with no time limit.
• Pro Trial: Enjoy a 6-day full-featured trial for unlimited servers and advanced features.
